newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas slips in Q4 but only two deals don.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas slips in Q4 but only two deals don.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were down in thin trade on Tuesday morning.

Only two deals were done for a total of 45 lots. October slipped by 0.09 penny a therm from Monday's settlement price to trade at 10.80 pence, while November was off by 0.2 pennny a therm to trade at 12.25 pence.
Bids and offers were posted on either side of previous settlement levels from December through to March.
But in front months August and September the offers by the close stood well above the previous settlement level.

August was offered at 11 pence after settling on Monday at 9.25 pence, while September was offered at 11.30 pence against a previous settlement level of 9.34 pence. No bids were posted in these months.
